summary: First full test pass of CEC Connect (AAWTA Community Engagement Portal). Backend: created a pytest regression suite (96 tests) covering public endpoints, spam/honeypot, rate limiting, the auth 401/403 matrix, applications CRUD + status + notes + convert, members (manual add, self-service edit incl. role-escalation guard, onboarding, suspend/restore), documents + e-signature (incl. re-sign block), goals, activity reports, announcements (+role targeting), events approval, messages, notifications, resources, settings, users/authorized-emails/role changes, audit log, dashboard stats and all 6 reports in JSON+CSV -> 96/96 PASS. Frontend: Playwright E2E on the public site (all 9 nav pages + all 3 public forms returning correct AMB/VOL/INQ reference numbers + consent guard), the admin portal (dashboard stats+charts, all 13 sidebar routes, application filter/search/detail/4 tabs/note/status/convert-to-member, add member, member detail tabs + public-directory toggle + suspend/restore, create document, publish announcement, approve a member-submitted event, add resource, settings persisting across reload, authorize email, change user role, reports preview + CSV) and the member portal (dashboard w/ onboarding %, profile save+persist, onboarding toggle 0%->8%, sign document, goal progress slider + status persist, activity report, announcement request, event submit as 'Submitted', messages/resources). Mobile 390px verified: no horizontal overflow, sidebar drawer works. FOUND 3 HIGH/CRITICAL DEFECTS: (a) all file uploads returned 500 due to a load_dotenv timing bug in storage.py - I fixed this and re-verified the full attach->submit->admin-view->download flow; (b) GET /api/files/{id}/download requires NO auth (verified anonymous 200 with file body) exposing applicant resumes; (c) PUT /api/goals/{id} is an IDOR (verified a member overwriting another member's goal). Plus a frontend route role-guard gap, a duplicate/buggy member selector in the goal dialog, and an un-debounced slider firing one PUT per input event.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER (load_dotenv timing bug). Every file upload returned 500. storage.py read EMERGENT_LLM_KEY at module import time, but server.py imports `storage as storage_mod` on line 13 BEFORE calling load_dotenv() on line 17, so EMERGENT_KEY was None and POST /objstore/api/v1/storage/init returned '400 Bad Request'. Impact while broken: applicants could not attach resume/headshot/supporting docs on /apply, and admins could not attach files to documents. Fix applied: storage.py now calls load_dotenv(Path(__file__).parent / '.env') at import (same pattern already used by emailer.py). Verified after backend restart: public upload -> 200, UI FileField shows the filename chip, application submits with the attachment, admin Files tab lists it and the download link returns 200. PLEASE KEEP THIS FIX.

No authentication whatsoever - VERIFIED by uploading a file and fetching it with zero credentials: returned 200 with the file body. The endpoint declares 'authorization' header and 'auth' query params and never uses them. Applicant resumes, headshots and signed documents are anonymously downloadable to anyone who has/guesses a file id (ids are 12 hex chars, and they are also embedded in admin pages).

IDOR - no ownership or role check. VERIFIED: the ambassador session (Test User, mem_bab4baedc2f1) successfully sent progress=99 to a goal belonging to a different member (Jane Vol, mem_7b845a47879f) and got 200; the value persisted. Any member can mutate any other member's goal progress/status/approved flag.

minor.issue: Rate limit is an in-process dict keyed on request.client.host. Behind the k8s ingress every visitor can share the same client IP, so 8 submissions in 10 min from ANY users can lock out all legitimate applicants globally. It is also reset on every backend restart and not shared across workers. Recommend keying on X-Forwarded-For (first hop) and/or persisting counters in Mongo.
Superseded - see critical list (verified anonymous download).
Superseded - see critical list (verified cross-member IDOR).

Reference number is derived from count_documents(type)+1, which is not race-safe and re-uses numbers after deletions (two concurrent submissions can get the same ref). Use an atomic counter document with $inc.
Returns 200 (ok) for a non-existent application id instead of 404, unlike the sibling /status endpoint.
When target_roles/target_states are empty the notify loop iterates over ALL members - fine now, but there is no cap/batching; the create is also fully synchronous per-member (no bulk insert).

ui_bugs.issue: TWO member pickers are rendered. The first one (SelectField, data-testid='field-member_id', label 'Assign to member') is populated with member NAMES as option values, so selecting from it sets member_id to a display name and the created goal is orphaned (member_id='Test User'). The second select (data-testid='goal-member-select') is the correct id-based one. The buggy SelectField on line ~53 should be deleted.
onChange of <input type=range> fires api.put per input event - 5 arrow presses produced 6 PUT /api/goals calls; a real mouse drag will fire dozens of writes. Debounce (or commit on onMouseUp/onBlur).

Each uploaded attachment appears TWICE in the admin Files tab ('resume: qa_resume.txt' and 'resume file: qa_resume.txt', header reads 'Files (2)' for one upload). Apply.jsx line ~33 copies every file key into `${k}_file` while keeping the original key, and ApplicationDetail counts every object-with-an-id. Pick one key.
Testability gap: the 12 dashboard StatCards and the Preview/CSV buttons on each report card have no data-testid, so they can only be selected by visible text.

integration_issues.flow: Member accessing staff-only portal routes by direct URL
integration_issues.issue: ProtectedRoute only checks 'is logged in', not role. An ambassador session that types /portal/applications, /portal/members, /portal/users, /portal/settings, /portal/reports or /portal/audit gets the full staff page shell rendered (H1 'User Management', 'Portal Settings', 'Audit Log', filter dropdowns, search boxes). No data leaks - the backend correctly returns 403 and every page shows its empty state - but the app must redirect to /portal or show 'Not authorized' instead of rendering admin screens to members.

Every public page load fires GET /api/auth/me which 401s for anonymous visitors, producing a stream of red 'Failed to load resource: 401' console errors on the marketing site. Functionally harmless but noisy; skip the call when no session cookie/first-visit flag exists.

issues: 'Submit an Inquiry' secondary button uses a dark slate fill on the dark navy hero - contrast against the surrounding hero is low and it reads as disabled
The three hero CTAs wrap so 'Submit an Inquiry' and 'Member Login' share a row and sit flush to the viewport edge

'New Applications' stat counts inquiries as applications (33 of 38 were inquiries before cleanup), which inflates the headline number - consider excluding type='inquiry' or splitting into a separate 'Open Inquiries' card

action_items: KEEP the tester's storage.py load_dotenv fix - without it 100% of file uploads 500. Better long-term: move load_dotenv() above the `import storage`/`from emailer import` lines in server.py, or read EMERGENT_LLM_KEY lazily inside init_storage().

Require authentication on GET /api/files/{id}/download (or issue short-lived signed URLs) - VERIFIED that an anonymous request returns 200 with the file contents, exposing applicant resumes/headshots and signed documents.
Add an ownership/role check to PUT /api/goals/{goal_id} - VERIFIED that a member can overwrite another member's goal progress.
Add role-based guarding to /portal/* routes in App.js (e.g. ProtectedRoute roles={STAFF}) so members can't render Applications/Members/Users/Settings/Reports/Audit screens by URL.
Delete the duplicate buggy 'Assign to member' SelectField (data-testid=field-member_id) in Goals.jsx - it writes a member NAME into member_id and orphans the goal.
Debounce the goal progress slider so dragging doesn't fire a PUT per pixel.

Make the public-submission rate limit proxy-aware (X-Forwarded-For) and/or Mongo-backed; the current per-process client.host limit can lock out all applicants behind the ingress after 8 total submissions/10 min.
Make reference numbers atomic ($inc counter) instead of count_documents()+1.
Return 404 from PUT /api/applications/{id}/assign for unknown ids.
Stop duplicating attachment keys in Apply.jsx (`${k}_file`) so the Files tab doesn't double-count.
Skip GET /api/auth/me on anonymous public pages to stop the 401 console-error stream.
Add data-testid to dashboard StatCards and Report Preview/CSV buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1116 lines with 20+ domains in one file - split into routers (auth, applications, members, documents, content, admin) before it grows further.
GET /api/files/{file_id}/download declares 'authorization' and 'auth' parameters and then never uses them - dead parameters that give a false impression of access control.

PUT /api/goals/{goal_id} and PUT /api/resources/{res_id} accept raw Dict[str, Any] rather than a Pydantic model; goals at least whitelists keys, resources does not (a caller can inject arbitrary fields, incl. 'access_roles').
Unused local variable 'settings = await get_settings_doc()' in submit_application and add_member_manual.
create_session sets the cookie with samesite='none'/secure=True which is correct for the preview host, but there is no CSRF protection on any state-changing endpoint while cookie auth is enabled.
The public /api/public/upload endpoint has no rate limit and no auth - 25MB uploads can be posted anonymously without any throttle.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/{conftest.py,backend_test.py}; run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; do not edit it). Gotchas learned: (1) EmailStr rejects the .test TLD - use @example.com for test emails; (2) TestRateLimit intentionally trips the 429 limiter, which then blocks UI form submissions for ~10 min - restart backend (`sudo supervisorctl restart backend`) to clear the in-memory counter before running Playwright form tests; (3) clicking data-testid=logout-btn deletes the seeded session token from user_sessions - re-upsert it; (4) React range inputs need real keyboard/mouse interaction (page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')) - synthetic el.value + dispatchEvent does not trigger React onChange; (5) admin announcement requests and Users' active-user list are behind Tabs, click the tab before asserting. Still untested: Emergent Google OAuth callback (cannot be automated), Resend email delivery (fire-and-forget by design), file upload/download via the UI FileField/UploadButton, Messages compose flow from the admin UI, and the /portal/messages read/unread badge.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) UPLOADS 500 (fixed by tester): storage.py line 6 read EMERGENT_LLM_KEY at module import, but server.py imports `storage as storage_mod` on line 13 while load_dotenv() only runs on line 17. Because the key lives solely in /app/backend/.env (not the process env), EMERGENT_KEY was None, so POST {proxy}/objstore/api/v1/storage/init returned 400 and every put_object raised -> 500 on /api/upload and /api/public/upload. Repro: POST a multipart file to /api/public/upload -> 500, backend.err.log shows 'requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 400 ... /storage/init'. Fix: load_dotenv(Path(__file__).parent / '.env') at the top of storage.py (mirrors emailer.py). Verified: upload 200, UI attach + admin Files tab + download all work. 2) UNAUTH FILE DOWNLOAD: download_file() takes `authorization`/`auth` params but never validates them and has no Depends(get_current_user); verified anonymous GET /api/files/{id}/download -> 200 with body. 3) GOAL IDOR: update_goal() only depends on get_current_user and never compares g['member_id'] to the caller's member record; verified ambassador token mutated another member's goal -> 200 + persisted. 4) ROUTE-GUARD GAP: App.js ProtectedRoute (lines 67-72) only checks `!user` and never compares user.role to the route, while PortalLayout merely hides links via NAV_ITEMS.roles - so a member typing a staff URL mounts the admin component (backend 403s, so the page renders its empty state; no data leak, but admin UI is shown). 5) GOAL DIALOG: Goals.jsx renders both a SelectField whose options are `members.map(m => m.name)` (SelectField emits the option value, i.e. the name) and a second correct id-based select, so the first writes a name into member_id and the goal becomes unresolvable.
